title: Global Oils and Foot Accessories Catalog
scope_note: This is a creative, global-inspired catalog dataset with 3,000 distinct catalog records. Names and regional fields are for inspiration, sourcing taxonomy, and product-collection organization; they do not certify geographic origin, authenticity, therapeutic effect, sustainability status, or regulatory compliance for any product. Validate supplier documentation, botanical identity, and country of origin before commercial use.
safety_notice: Essential oils are concentrated substances. Do not ingest them, do not apply them undiluted to skin, and do not drip them directly into bathwater. For a foot ritual, use only properly formulated, skin-safe products on intact skin and follow the manufacturer label. Stop if irritation occurs. Seek clinician guidance before DIY topical or foot-soak routines when diabetes, neuropathy, poor circulation, open wounds, infection, severe sensitivity, pregnancy-related concerns, or other relevant health conditions apply.

ritual_builder_steps: Choose a safe, pre-formulated skin or ambient aroma product.
Choose one foot-care tool and one comfort accessory.
Set a 5–10 minute timer for any soak.
Dry feet carefully and record your mood before and after.
prompt_deck: Style a tray with one texture: linen, wood, ceramic, or glass.
Use a reflection card to rate your sensory experience.
Choose a global-inspired color palette for your setup.
data_quality_notes: Records are deliberately generated as catalog concepts to reach 3,000 entries; duplicated core botanicals may appear in different format, country-reference, or collection-theme variants.
This dataset is not a supplier directory and should not be used as a safety, medical, or regulatory database.
